name: Pigeon
timbre: frayed, sleepless woman's voice, cooing at rest but cracking into a piercing shriek, catching with sobs
pitch: mezzo-soprano, erratic, jumps to a high shriek then sinks to a sulky low
accent: lower-middle-class Home Counties English, a little flattened and common
reference_style: Harried mother guarding her eggs: long, repetitive grievance litanies, shrieked 'Serpent!', contemptuous dismissal, then sulky settling. She talks at Alice, not to her.
